Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 150 cm. Product weight: 2.5 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Compact artificial Christmas tree designed to add festive detail and serve as a focal point for home decorations.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal materials to provide a defined appearance and lasting quality.
Versatile green finish allows it to complement various holiday displays and coordinate with other decorative pieces.
Easy to position and adjust within your arrangement, offering a flexible finishing touch for seasonal styling.
Guarantee - 1 month

Partial assembly required

7906816232716.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Slim Pencil Design: This artificial Christmas tree features a space-saving pencil shape, ideal for smaller rooms, hallways and corners. With 300 realistic green PVC branch tips, it creates a natural and full festive appearance.
250 Warm White LED Lights: Pre-lit with 250 warm white LED lights, the tree creates a cosy and welcoming Christmas atmosphere, making it a lovely addition to your seasonal decorations.
Sturdy Metal Stand: The durable iron stand provides reliable support to keep the tree upright and stable throughout the festive season. Plastic protective caps help prevent scratches and marks on your floor.
Easy Hinged Assembly: The hinged branch design allows for quick and easy assembly and dismantling. The stand can also be folded for convenient, space-saving storage after the holidays.
Ideal Corner Decoration: With its slim profile, this pre-lit Christmas tree fits neatly into corners and smaller spaces, making it suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways and offices.
 
Specifications
Colour: Green
Material: PVC, Iron
Height: 150cm
Base Width: 67 cm
Number of Branch Tips: 300
Net Weight: 2 kg
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.
Keep the Tree Stand Straightly: It comes with an ultra sturdy iron stand, intended to keep the Christmas tree in an upright position all season long. Compared with plastic stand, the metal one, needless to say, is superior in every way, no matter lasting durability or great stability. Meanwhile, he plastic tips of the stand can also protect you floor from scratches.
Easy to Set up with Less Effort: The pencil Christmas tree consists of hinged sections, features super easy assembly as well as disassembly and requires you less effort to build. The day after the Christmas ends, you can store the hinged sections and folded stand together, and reuse them the next holiday.
Feel the Warm Brilliant Lights: There are 250 warm-color pre-stung LED lights on the Christmas tree, which give birth to a fairly tale mood, beautiful like the stars. Twinkling Christmas lights make the whole night become extremely warm. By the way, the LED lights leave you no worry about using safety so that you can appreciate and enjoy it at ease.
Fantastic Decoration in Corner: Whether being placed next to the fire place or any corner in your house, the pre-lit Christmas tree will be a perfect decoration and takes up less floor. It will enchant your family and friends, while spreading the Christmas spirit to let you get into such joyful atmosphere, share happiness and bless good luck.
Slim Lifelike Pencil Design: Unique pencil Christmas tree molded from real tree, of which all green color is full of life, makes it hard for you to distinguish between real and artificial one. 300 Branch tips showcase lush look, which are delicately crafted from 100% new PVC material, no odor, non flammable, non allergic and non deformation as well.
Guarantee - 1 year
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required
With stand

The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team

STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

A slim I initial with a snowman cuddled round it, which works rather well given how narrow the letter is — there's plenty of cheerful detail either side of it to make the whole thing feel balanced.

It's printed rather than painted, at high definition, so you get that convincing three-dimensional effect without any actual raised edges. The acrylic is flat-cut, just under four millimetres, so it hangs flush against the tree.

Gold cord comes pre-tied, so nothing to do before it goes up. Being acrylic rather than glass there's no risk from a knock, and because it's flat it packs away in a box rather than needing its own padding.

Material: 2D flat acrylic
Narrow I initial balanced by a snowman on either side
Printed depth rather than raised edges to catch
Flat-cut, sits flush against the branches
Pre-tied gold cord included
Packs flat with no padding required
Guarantee - 1 month

Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: 60cm hanging meteor windmill | 96 vibrant colour LEDs | 5m lead cable | IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
60CM METEOR WINDMILL : 96 vibrant colour LEDs in a hanging windmill design.
HANGING DESIGN : Perfect for windows and walls.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable and IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
INDOOR DECORATION : Windows, walls, living rooms and parties.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold and red finish and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Carry Handle
The handle provides a defined place to hold the item when moving it. It is useful for carrying between locations and returning it to storage after use.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Wood. Colour: Gold and Red. Product measurements: height 12 cm. Quantity: 2 pack.

Features a convenient carry handle for easy transport between locations and simple storage after use.

Inflatable Christmas Presents
These inflatable Christmas presents add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and polyester construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Versatile design allows it to serve as a focal point or part of a coordinated group.
